community.testimonials_subtitle: Real voices from the JUSTCODE-KL community. Drag the dial, swipe, or use the arrows.

1.quote: I joined JUSTCODE-KL in 2023, in my first semester, without knowing anything about computer science or tech. I started by learning JavaScript, React and TypeScript – the very technologies that helped me build this website today. Now I'm a mentor in the community and share my knowledge with everyone who is new to tech.

2.quote: Joining JUSTCODE-KL was one of the best decisions of my studies. I found a warm, supportive community where you learn by doing: hands-on workshops, team projects and exchanges with people from very different backgrounds. Thanks to that, I didn't just grow technically – I also gained the confidence to present my ideas and work in a team. If you're hesitating to take the step, I can recommend it without reservation.

3.role: Computer Science · Intelligent Systems & Machine Learning
3.quote: At JUSTCODE-KL, I don't just pass on my knowledge and experience as a mentor – I learn something new every day myself. What motivates me most is supporting young talents on their journey, tackling challenges together and seeing first ideas turn into real projects. For me, JUSTCODE-KL is a place where we don't just code together, we grow together.

4.quote: The hackathons showed me what I am really capable of. 24 hours, a team of strangers, and we won second place. That weekend taught me more than a full semester.

5.quote: My GitHub portfolio looks impressive thanks to the project workshops. I went from zero public repos to seven shipped projects in one semester.

events.heading: Our Events
events.intro: We don't just write code – we bring exciting topics to the stage, visit tech events and learn together.

talkshow.title: Data Science, Data Analytics or Data Engineering?
talkshow.subtitle: // Differences & similarities
talkshow.description: On 25 August 2026, Meryl Kwamen organised and hosted a talk show all about data. She showed how Data Science, Data Analytics and Data Engineering differ, where they overlap and which skills each field requires. Afterwards, the conversation continued over a shared buffet.

itday.title: IT Day Cologne 2026
itday.subtitle: // Experiencing tech in practice
itday.description: In 2026, the JUSTCODE-KL team went to IT Day in Cologne to learn from professionals. The talks ranged from company structures to modern tech stacks with Java, Spring Boot, GitLab, Kubernetes and Terraform. We saw how software is built, shipped and run in real-world jobs – and made new connections in the tech scene.

git.title: Version control with Git
git.subtitle: // Git, GitHub & GitLab
git.description: No team project without version control: in this workshop we learned how to track changes with Git and how GitHub and GitLab make collaboration easier.
points: Git basics: repository, commit, push & pull
Working with branches and merging changes

trello.subtitle: // Project management in teams

points: Setting up boards, lists and cards
Assigning and prioritising tasks in a team

career.description: Technical skills alone aren’t enough – you also have to show them. This workshop covered how to write a convincing CV and cover letter and how to prepare for a job interview.
